answer_1.quote: We introduce an audio-visual spoken dialogue system that directly understands the audio-visual of the user's face video and generates appropriate responses with audio-visual face video.

answer_2.quote: For the semantic quality, we first generate transcriptions from the synthesized audio-visual output using an off-the-shelf ASR model, and employ standard metrics used for text-based dialogue generation: log-perplexity (PPL), BLEU, METEOR, F1, D-1, and D-2.
